summary: Old bronze darkened to a deep brown patina with a soft satin sheen, as on doors, grilles, urns and statues.
_comment: Aged architectural and statuary bronze: cast bronze under a deep brown patina, waxed and handled: doors, eagles, urns, grilles. Opaque, a metal: the patina is drawn as a darker, softly mottled base colour and a satin roughness that wanders with it, on metalness 1, so it still reflects as metal and not as brown paint. The maps are generated (L2, gen_bronze_aged.py; the wish list said L3, but the bronze scans are tagged eroded, rusted and scratched, and this is a kept, waxed patina; they were not tried). The mean colour (0.20, 0.125, 0.062) is a judgement: a bright bronze darkened to under a third by its patina. APPROXIMATE: the metal edge tint (F82) and complex IOR are not carried by the library (F-LC-6). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1), in the wish list's order on the older Grime mask: scratches (overlay 1, damage), pitting (overlay 2), and a deposit (overlay 3, Dust01) whose colour set green makes the verdigris the wish list also wants. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Bronze_Aged_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Mean linear base colour (0.20, 0.125, 0.062): a bright bronze's reflectance (about 0.71, 0.43, 0.18) darkened to under a third by a brown patina; mean roughness 0.38 for a waxed satin; metalness 1 (the patina is thin and the face still reflects as metal). Physically Based has no bronze entry. meters_per_tile 0.1 is the s01 option's length; the generator makes the tile at that size.
